newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 drifts lower into weekend.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 drifts lower into weekend.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index failed to make any progress on Friday after a subdued performance on Wall Street and ahead of an onslaught of major company earnings.
The leading index ended 11.4 points lower at 4,851.5 for a net loss of 25-points on the week. The Mid-250 traded within a six-point range and finished 3.7 lower at 4,474.7.

"Volumes are beginning to drop off and business is slowing down for the summer recess. Concerns about interest rates are slowing the market down but it lacks any major impetus to move either way at the moment," said the head of market-making at one leading brokerage.
